What mode to interpret the function field as.

Run an 'import sequence' script to build a frame sequence list from the contents of an 'edl' file. Note that this is not a standard EDL (eg CMX) file. Each line in the file simply defines a separate image sequence to import in the form:

  imagesequence.%04d.ext in out head tail

Where in and out are the start/end frame numbers of the clip and head/tail are the number of frames to trim from the start and end.

Each sequence in the list is expanded into the 'sequence' knob so that each line contains the name of the file to read for that frame: line 1 = frame 1, line 10 = frame 10.

Finally, the script replaces the file knob text with '[lindex [knob sequence] [frame]]' to look up the filename from the 'sequence' knob and sets the first/last frame knobs to 1 through the number of frames in the expanded list.

Input data is taken to be in this color transform. The first menu level is the color space family name. The sub menu items are the names of the color spaces themselves. description.text: If there is an alpha channel, divide color data by the alpha before converting from the color transform, and then multiply by the alpha afterwards. This will correct the color of the partially-transparent pixels produced by most renderers.
Filename of proxy image. This proxy image will be used if proxy mode is on and the required resolution is less than or equal to the file's size.

Proxy image will be read if down-rez of format is smaller or equal to this. Typically it will be guessed correctly from the file header but you can change to set a different pixel aspect ratio if necessary.
